title: October 2026
monthlyRecap: October focused on strengthening GBT’s website and local search presence. We shortened 125 page titles, resolved a 22-page duplicate-title group, added two missing descriptions and refined the privacy-policy and sitemap titles. We also completed the Search Console review, set up Bing Places and secured Google Business Profile access.

We added and verified 25 internal links across 21 pages, helping visitors find relevant services. The latest audit shows a 100/100 SEO score with no SEO issues detected. In November, we’ll build on this foundation with more internal linking, local profile improvements and continued website checks.

visuals.caption: October 2026 reporting — latest technical audit, November 1, 2026

recap: GBT achieved a 100/100 SEO audit score following the website cleanup. We shortened lengthy titles, replaced duplicate titles and filled in missing descriptions. The latest audit, dated November 1, checked 293 pages and reported no SEO issues, broken pages or blocked pages.
technicalSeo.completedWorkHtml:
PeriodWork completedWhat changed
October 2026SEO title lengthShortened lengthy titles, removed repeated company-name suffixes and retained page topics. 125 titles; each saved title is 60 characters or fewer. 125 saved titles checked; three live title tags spot-checked. Follow-up audit: zero long titles.
October 2026Duplicate titlesReplaced repeated homepage titles with unique page titles and corrected the default title template. 22-page group: 21 replacements; homepage title preserved. All 21 replacements verified in live HTML. Follow-up audit: zero duplicate-title findings.
October 2026Meta descriptionsAdded page-specific descriptions to the flatbed trucking and supply chain diversification articles. 2 articles. Both complete description tags verified in live HTML. Follow-up audit: zero missing descriptions.
October 2026Utility-page titlesExpanded the privacy-policy and sitemap titles to use the full company name. 2 title refinements on pages already included in the duplicate-title group. Both live title tags verified on October 7, after the saved audit. These are not two additional unique pages.
October 2026Internal-link recommendationsAudited published content and prepared anchor text, source and destination URLs, placement context and priorities. 155 published URLs; 300 recommendations across 118 source pages; 20 destinations. 172 high-priority and 128 medium-priority placements prepared. All 20 destination URLs returned HTTP 200 at the audit.
October 2026Existing internal-link inventoryCatalogued distinct source, anchor and destination combinations in the extracted published content. 2,132 existing internal-link records. Reference inventory prepared; repeated identical links within a page consolidated. These are existing records, not newly installed links.
October 2026Technical audit verificationSaved the follow-up crawl and reviewed the supplied before-and-after dashboard images. 282 URLs: 186 successful, 96 redirected, zero broken and zero blocked. Saved October 7 audit: 99/100 and eight findings. October 11 dashboard image: 100/100 and zero displayed findings.
internalLinkingNote: On October 14, we added and verified 25 contextual links across 21 pages, connecting existing content to six key service and industry pages. These are the completed placements from 300 recommendations; the remaining 275 are planned work.

PeriodAreaUpdate
October 2026Google Search ConsoleCompleted the Search Console audit. Completion confirmed by Gary. Detailed findings and performance baseline still need to be recorded.
October 2026Google Business ProfileObtained access for ongoing local search management. Access confirmed by Gary. Profile review and optimization remain separate, planned work.
October 2026Bing PlacesAdded GBT to Bing Places and synced its business profiles. Setup and syncing completed, as confirmed by Gary.

nextSteps: In November, we plan to add more useful internal links, improve GBT’s Google Business Profile and continue website health checks. We’ll also review how search engines and AI tools understand the site, check inquiry tracking and identify ways to make it easier for visitors to contact GBT.
